name: Nimble Loose
description: Set both feet square to the mark and seat the arrow nock on the string in one smooth motion.

name: Level Quiver
description: Hook three fingers on the string, draw to the cheek, hold steady and loose a flat arrow at close range.

name: Limbbump
description: Touch the string hand to the same spot on the cheek and release cleanly for a repeatable straight arrow.

name: Vanes Husk
description: Swing the bow stave across the body to knock an incoming blade or club aside.

name: Riser Drop
description: Drive the lower bow limb forward into the ribs of a foe who has closed the distance.

name: Risercount
description: Watch the fletching and grass tips to judge a crosswind before the draw begins.

name: Calm Bowgrip
description: Run a thumb along the nock and string by touch to confirm the arrow sits true before drawing.

name: Skipping Arrowrest
description: Plant the lead foot and turn the hips to set a stable shooting line toward the mark.

name: Anchorblow
description: Draw the string with a thumb ring, hold at full draw and release a heavy short-range arrow.

name: Limb Dash
description: Pull an arrow from the hip quiver and nock it in one motion for a fast first shot.

name: Serving Lid
description: Turn the leather bracer into a small shield and slap a thrown blade aside.

name: Skipping Anchor
description: Widen the feet to shoulder width and settle the weight evenly before lifting the bow.

name: Planted Limbtip
description: Hold the bow arm straight with the stave raised to cover the face against thrown stones.

name: Limbstrike
description: Draw by pulling the shoulder blades together, hold, and loose a steady arrow at medium range.

name: Even Bowstring
description: Practice the full draw and release count without an arrow to steady form and learn the string's give.

name: Looseblow
description: Loose an arrow the instant the draw reaches anchor, trading aim for speed at close range.

name: Flat Nock
description: Swing the bow stave sideways like a short staff against a foe within reach.

name: Forward Release
description: Grip an arrow shaft in the fist and jab the broadhead into an attacker at arm's length.

name: Bowgrip Count
description: Find the pivot point of the riser by hand and set the grip so the bow sits level.

name: Stepping Draw
description: Pace out the distance to a marked post and fix its range by step count.

name: Sudden Snapshot
description: Hold the drawn string with relaxed fingers until the shaking stops, then loose a straight arrow.

name: Downward Anchor
description: Release at the end of an exhale for a steady arrow aimed at the chest of a stationary target.

name: Vaneslid
description: Cross the bow in front of the chest to turn a glancing blow away.

name: Drawcowl
description: Snap the loose string toward the eyes of a close attacker to break his rhythm.

name: Calm Limb
description: Draw the bow slowly in three stages, feeling each forearm tendon take the load before full draw.

name: Serving Strike
description: Hold full draw through a slow count of five, then loose an arrow with no flinch.

name: Leaden Loose
description: Let the string roll off the fingertips without a twitch so the arrow leaves straight.

name: Volleydrop
description: Keep the bow arm still after the release so the arrow keeps its line to the mark.

name: Firm Arrowrest
description: Drop low behind cover and loose a short arrow at a target above the cover line.

name: Upward Riser
description: Drop to one knee with the bow elbow braced on the thigh and fire a steadier long arrow.

name: Vanescowl
description: Turn the bow hand outward to slip a thrusting blade past the ribs and clear the line.

name: Light Volley
description: Slide one step to the side while drawing so a pursuer's rush passes the shooting line.

name: Anchorhop
description: Walk with the strung bow low and the arrow hand free, ready to nock at a moment's notice.

name: Tending Vanes
description: Press the limbs against the knee to feel for cracks and uneven bend before relying on the bow.

name: Limbtip Dash
description: Draw to full length with the bones stacked in line and loose a hard flat arrow at long range.

name: Vanesdrop
description: Bring the bow stave down across the forearm of an attacker who has grabbed the string arm.

name: Hard Bowstring
description: Reach over the shoulder for an arrow and nock it without taking the eyes off the target.

name: Open Snapshot
description: Thread a thin line of own qi along the shaft during the draw so the arrow flies faster.

name: Watching Limbtip
description: Send a pulse of qi through the string to feel whether the arrow nock sits true.

name: Straight Release
description: Draw with the breath sunk to the dantian and hold full draw without a tremor.

name: Quiver Blow
description: Loose a quick arrow with a flick of qi at the tip to carry it flat over a short span.

name: Nockcowl
description: Coat the stave in qi and rap an incoming blade aside with the rebound of the limb.

name: Downward Volley
description: Jab the qi-hardened arrow point into the gap in a foe's guard at arm's length.

name: Riserdash
description: Draw on the inhale, hold at the top of the breath and loose on the exhale with a trickle of qi.

name: Tending Nock
description: Pluck the string and listen to its note to judge draw weight and the state of the string.

name: Quick Limb
description: Loose on a steady exhale so the qi leaves with the arrow and does not bleed away.

name: Riserskitter
description: Take two quick steps on one breath to shift the shooting line before the next draw.

name: Nockwedge
description: Twist the string arm out of a grab and use the freed bow to turn the next blow.

name: Square Anchor
description: Swing the short upper limb into a foe's wrist with a pulse of qi in the stave.

name: Drawhit
description: Hold the breath at full draw to freeze the aim, then loose a steadier arrow to a longer mark.

name: Bowgrip Blow
description: Loose arrows in steady rhythm at a distant mark to pin a patrol behind cover.

name: Hard Volley
description: Lean past the cover edge, loose one arrow with a push of qi, and drop back at once.

name: Volleypace
description: Shift the quiver and bow on the march so both stay quiet and ready for a quick nock.

name: Arrowrest Cowl
description: Take a cut on the stave, rolling the wrist so the edge slides off the wood.

name: Quivercount
description: Read bent grass and trampled ground to find where an unseen foe has passed.

name: Downward Draw
description: Snap a spare arrow across a foe's hand and drive the broken shaft into the grip.

name: Loosedrop
description: Rake an arrow from the quiver into the nock and loose it with a flick of qi.

name: Gnawing Loose
description: Hold three arrows fanned in the draw hand and loose them one after another with minimal qi.

name: Warm Bowstring
description: Breathe once between shots and read the fall of the last arrow to correct the next.

name: Gentle Vanes
description: Count remaining arrows by touch alone without looking down from the target.

name: Drawamble
description: Step back one pace after each shot to keep distance from a closing foe while nocking.

name: Level Draw
description: Draw the bow in step with the stride and loose at the moment both feet are planted.

name: Short Snapshot
description: Loose while trotting by timing the string release to the downward beat of the stride.

name: Limbamble
description: Pivot on the lead foot while nocking so the body faces a flanking foe without losing the shooting line.

name: Open Quiver
description: Twist at the waist and loose an arrow at a pursuer without stopping the run.

name: Nock Note
description: Slow the breath between strides to steady the pulse so the aim settles on the target.

name: Nabbing Vanes
description: Hook the limb tip around a pursuer's ankle or reaching arm and pull him off balance.

name: Limbpause
description: Dip the shoulder and sweep the stave across the body to turn a thrown stone.

name: Vanesbump
description: Touch the anchor point mid-stride and loose a flat arrow before the footing shifts.

name: Serving Dash
description: Light the shaft with a thread of qi so its flight shows the line of fall in dim light.

name: Single Limbtip
description: Hold qi in the arrowhead through the draw and loose it to punch deeper into the target.

name: Straight Riser
description: Push qi to the feathers so the shaft spins and holds a flat line through a crosswind.

name: Deep Limb
description: Count the number of qi-lit shafts left in the quiver by the faint warmth of each.

name: Snug Bowgrip
description: Lay qi along the lower limb and use it to parry a low cut at the thigh.

name: Snapshot Lid
description: Flick the loose quiver strap across a foe's face to blind him for a heartbeat.

name: Gnawing Nock
description: Pluck the string in a rhythm with qi to rattle a foe's concentration while he advances.
